s: And I'm Lena, and today we are talking about fashion and style.
Fashion is a great topic because everyone wears clothes, and everyone has an opinion about them.
Some people love fashion, and some people just want to feel comfortable.
Let's start with a simple idea.
An outfit is a full set of clothes that you wear together, like a shirt, trousers, and shoes.
When I plan an outfit, I think about the weather first, and then I think about where I am going.
A good outfit fits the day.
For work, I like a clean and simple outfit.
For a party, I like something more fun.
And the fit is so important.
If your clothes fit well, you look good even in a simple outfit.
Fit means how clothes sit on your body.
A jacket can be beautiful, but if the fit is wrong, it just feels uncomfortable.
I once bought a jacket that was too tight, and I never wore it again.
And fit is not only about size.
A good fit also means the shape suits you, so you can move and breathe easily.
When the fit is right, you forget about your clothes and enjoy your day.

Now, let's talk about what is trendy right now.
Trendy means popular and fashionable at the moment.
This year, big jackets and bright colours are very trendy.
I have seen so many trendy shops with wide trousers and soft sweaters.
Last year, one colour was trendy, and this year it is something else.
That is why I try not to follow every trend.
I like to mix one trendy piece with my normal clothes.
That way, my outfit feels fresh, but it still feels like me.
And speaking of fresh, let's talk about pattern.
A pattern is a repeated design on cloth, like stripes or flowers.
A striped shirt is a classic pattern, and a floral dress is a happy pattern.
Patterns can change a whole outfit.
A plain shirt with a strong pattern on the scarf can look very stylish.
And stylish means fashionable and attractive.
You do not need expensive clothes to look stylish.
A stylish person often wears simple clothes with confidence.
A stylish look is about how you put things together.
Fabric is the cloth that clothes are made from, like cotton or wool.
Soft cotton fabric feels cool in summer, and warm wool fabric feels cosy in winter.
I always check the fabric before I buy something.
If the fabric feels rough, I will not enjoy wearing it.
Good fabric can make a cheap shirt feel wonderful, and bad fabric can ruin a lovely design.
A tailor is a person who makes clothes or changes them so they fit you.
A tailor is a real hero.
If your trousers are too long, a tailor can shorten them.
If your jacket is too wide, a tailor can fix it.
I took a dress to a tailor last month, and she made it perfect.
The tailor changed the length and fixed the shoulders.
That is the magic of a tailor.
A small change from a tailor can turn a good outfit into a great one.
Your wardrobe is all the clothes that you own.
My wardrobe is full of black and blue.
I want more colour in my wardrobe this year.
A good trick is to look at your wardrobe before you shop.
If your wardrobe already has five black shirts, you do not need another one.
And when you look at your wardrobe, think about accessories too.
An accessory is a small extra item, like a belt, a scarf, or a bag, that completes an outfit.
One accessory, like a bright scarf, can make a plain outfit look new.
Yes, an accessory is a small thing with a big effect.
A belt, a hat, or a pair of earrings can each be the perfect accessory.

Vintage means old but valuable and fashionable, from a past time.
A vintage jacket from the nineteen eighties can look so stylish today.
A vintage dress with a lovely pattern and soft fabric feels special in a way that new clothes do not.
And a vintage piece can be a wonderful accessory to a modern outfit, like an old bag with a new dress.

So, to remember today: think about your outfit, check the fit, try one trendy piece, enjoy a fun pattern, feel the fabric, visit a tailor, look at your wardrobe, add one accessory, and maybe find something vintage.
And remember, a stylish look is not about money.
It is about knowing what fits you and wearing it with confidence.
